Q: Google Apps Script logs (web app) don't show up in the new interface A:

Crazy enough, changing the script's container spreadsheet's general access from Restricted → Anyone with the link immediately made the doPost execution logs visible. Ofcourse this doesn't fix the issue and is only useful for debugging, it should be reverted afterward for security.

Q: Visual Studio Code Shortcut for switching between Copilot models? A:

Depending on your platform, you can press ⌥ + ⌘ + . on Mac (AKA Opt + Cmd + .).

See the complete cheat sheet for reference.

Q: Is there any way we can help Stack Overflow Website get back up? A:

aktually they just serve a different robots.txt to crawlers they've allowed.

Q: Google Script Trigger no longer activating properly A:

Chances are that you have added a tab or changed the order of tabs in the spreadsheet.

When you manually run a function that calls ss.getActiveSheet(), you get the tab that is currently open in the user interface.

When you call ss.getActiveSheet() in an installable trigger, there is no user interface context, and you always get the first tab in the spreadsheet, regardless of which tab you may have open in the user interface.

To make it work, use Spreadsheet.getSheetById() or Spreadsheet.getSheetByName().

See Spreadsheet.getActiveSheet().
